notes.title: Lu[Idle] 0.6 BIGGEST UPDATE YET
notes.notes:
Lu[Idle] 0.6 has been a long time in the making and its finally here! 
You can find the full patch notes in the discord server but here is a quick overview of what has been changed/added:
- The console now has 3 new options at the bottom for switching between the main things that the console did before.
- THERE ARE 2 NEW PRESTIGES! they both give extra rewards upon completing them equal to the difficulty of completing them.
- There is now many new options that have been moved from the console to the settings menu.
- The Lua guide book has been removed as I have made the typing part of the console for secret commands only and moved the things it did before into separate options that are easier to navigate to.

JOIN THE DISCORD FOR THE FULL PATCH NOTES - 
https://discord.gg/vnWGuSBCkv

Check out the announcement trailer for Lu[Idle] 0.6 that shows off some of the new content!

[previewyoutube=7kq9v8vFewk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.54
notes.notes: Fixed an issue that occurs after your first prestige which breaks the pixel by pixel image.

notes.title: Hot Fix / Small Content Update
notes.notes:
Content Update

- Added a "weak spot" to the Code Bar which adds a +0.1 Multiplier per weak spot clicked to the bytes 
      gained from clicking weak spots. The combo resets along with the multiplier if you fail to click a weak 
      spot within 3 seconds of clicking the previous weak spot.

Hot Fix

- Fixed an issue where your Pre-orders would be doubled whenever you launched the game.



Make sure to leave the game a good review if you like it :)

notes.title: Small update/fix
notes.notes:
In this tiny update/fix I changed an array having to do with the number that shows up when you click the code bar which now actually deletes the number after it fades away hopefully fixing performance issues.
I also added art to the prestige upgrades.

Make sure to give Lu[Idle] a good review if you like it :)
